blocks.orig: Ndutu Wilderness Camp is an intimate tented camp that from December to March strikes down in the Ndutu area of the Serengeti ecosystem, which coincides with the calving season of the Great Migration. The camp lies beautifully under shady trees and consists of twelve spacious ensuite tents with solar lighting. The restaurant is renowned for its warm service and cosy dining and meals are often served outside under starry African skies. The central lounge and bar area is a great place to meet other guests, and a campfire completes the natural safari ambience.
blocks.html: Ndutu Wilderness Camp is a small, intimate tented camp that is set up in the Ndutu area of the Serengeti ecosystem from December to March, the same period as the calving season of the Great Migration. Set in a lovely spot beneath shady trees, the camp has twelve spacious ensuite tents lit by solar power. The restaurant is known for its warm service and cosy dinners, and meals are frequently served outdoors beneath the starry African sky. You can meet fellow guests in the central lounge and bar area, while a campfire rounds off the natural safari atmosphere.

blocks.orig: This is a perfect place to witness the annual calving of the Wildebeest Migration, which comes with many opportunistic predators: lions, cheetahs, leopards, African wildcats, and striped and spotted hyenas. Last but not least, the diverse landscape in this area, ranging from forests to plains to soda lakes, makes it a unique place for bird watching.
blocks.html: Here you are in an ideal spot to see the yearly calving of the Wildebeest Migration, which attracts many opportunistic predators: lions, cheetahs, leopards, African wildcats, and striped and spotted hyenas. Finally, the varied scenery of this area, from forests and plains to soda lakes, makes it a unique destination for birdwatching.
